name: High-Impact Digital Blog Article
description: Engaging, SEO-optimized digital blog post with Magnetic Title, Story Hook, Subheaders, Core Takeaways, and Call-to-Action (CTA).
context: Digital content marketing, thought leadership blogs, industry insights, and educational articles for web audiences, LinkedIn, and corporate blogs.
rules:
1. Write in an engaging, conversational, yet authoritative tone.
2. Use short, readable paragraphs and punchy subheadings (H2, H3).
3. Provide actionable, practical takeaways for readers.
4. End with a compelling Call-to-Action (CTA) encouraging community engagement.
requirements:
- Catchy, Click-Worthy Title.
- Engaging Hook / Introduction.
- 3-4 clearly defined Sub-topics.
- Actionable Tips / Core Takeaways.
- Engaging Conclusion & Call-to-Action (CTA).

fields.label: Blog Post Title
fields.default: Transforming Public Health from the Grassroots: 5 Key Lessons from the Field

fields.label: Target Audience
fields.default: Development Practitioners, Policymakers, and Global Health Advocates

sections.title: The Hook & Introduction
sections.prompt: Relatable opening story, surprising statistic, or burning question that grabs reader attention.

sections.title: Core Insights & In-Depth Analysis
sections.prompt: Detailed exploration of the main topic broken down into logical thematic points.

sections.title: Practical Takeaways & Actionable Tips
sections.prompt: List of concrete, actionable recommendations readers can immediately implement.

sections.title: Conclusion & Call to Action (CTA)
sections.prompt: Inspiring wrap-up and a clear CTA (e.g., share thoughts, subscribe, join the initiative).

ai_system_prompt: You are a World-Class Digital Content Strategist and Thought Leader. Transform the input transcript/notes into a viral, insightful, and beautifully formatted blog post.

name: Press Release & News Story
description: High-impact journalism and corporate press release format with Catchy Headline, Dateline, Inverted Pyramid Lead, Quotes, and Media Boilerplate.
context: Public press releases, newsroom wire stories, media alerts, and journalistic coverage of events, product launches, or emergency briefings.
rules:
1. Follow the inverted pyramid structure (crucial 5 Ws in the first paragraph: Who, What, When, Where, Why).
2. Use punchy, objective journalistic tone in third person.
3. Include authentic quotes with speaker attribution.
4. Conclude with institutional boilerplate and media contact info.
requirements:
- Headline & Sub-headline.
- Dateline (City, Country).
- Strong Lead Paragraph (the hook and core news event).
- Body paragraphs with supporting context and statistics.
- Key Direct Quotes from leadership/spokespersons.
- About / Boilerplate and Media Contact section.

fields.label: Headline
fields.default: EASD Unveils Landmark Community Health Initiative to Combat Non-Communicable Diseases

sections.title: Lead Paragraph (The Core News)
sections.prompt: Immediate summary capturing Who, What, Where, When, and Why in 2-3 engaging sentences.

sections.title: Story Details & Background
sections.prompt: In-depth narrative explaining the background, impact, and significance of the announcement.

sections.title: Executive Quotes & Statements
sections.prompt: Direct quotes from leadership, subject matter experts, or key stakeholders with proper attribution.

sections.title: Key News Highlights & Milestones
sections.prompt: Bullet points outlining pivotal facts, figures, and immediate milestones.

sections.title: About Organization & Media Inquiries
sections.prompt: Standard institutional boilerplate description and media inquiry instructions.

ai_system_prompt: You are a Senior Bureau Chief and Veteran News Editor. Transform the input notes/audio into a crisp, engaging, and professional news story / press release adhering to AP Style guidelines.

name: Academic & Scientific Journal Article
description: Peer-reviewed journal paper format with Abstract, Introduction, Methodology, Results, Discussion, Conclusion, and Citations.
context: Scholarly publications, scientific research papers, clinical evaluations, and academic conference proceedings. Target audience includes researchers, academic peers, and scientific reviewers.
rules:
1. Write in objective, rigorous academic prose.
2. Ensure the Abstract contains a concise Background, Methods, Results, and Conclusion summary.
3. Findings must be backed by qualitative/quantitative evidence presented in the text.
4. Include structured references in standard APA/IEEE citation style.
requirements:
- Paper Title, Authors, and Institutional Affiliation.
- 150-250 word structured Abstract & Keywords.
- Introduction and Research Objectives.
- Methodology / Analytical Framework.
- Results, Statistical / Thematic Insights.
- Scholarly Discussion, Limitations & Future Scope.
- References list.

fields.label: Article Title
fields.default: Epidemiological Trends and Public Health Interventions in Urban Communities

fields.label: Keywords (comma separated)
fields.default: Public Health, NCD Prevention, Health Systems, Community Interventions

sections.title: Abstract
sections.prompt: Structured synthesis: Context, Objectives, Methodology, Principal Results, and Scientific Conclusion.

sections.title: 1. Introduction & Theoretical Framework
sections.prompt: Problem statement, literature overview, and core research questions.

sections.title: 2. Methodology & Study Design
sections.prompt: Sampling, data collection protocols, ethical approvals, and analytical methods.

sections.title: 3. Results & Empirical Findings
sections.prompt: Key empirical findings, statistical observations, and quantitative/qualitative data points.

sections.title: 4. Discussion & Implications
sections.prompt: Interpretation of results in relation to existing literature and policy implications.

sections.title: 5. Conclusion & Recommendations
sections.prompt: Final takeaways, research limitations, and future research directives.

sections.title: 6. References / Citations
sections.prompt: Scholarly references and bibliography.

tables.title: Summary of Key Variables and Findings

ai_system_prompt: You are a distinguished Principal Academic Investigator and Scientific Editor. Synthesize the provided research transcript/data into an authoritative, peer-reviewed academic journal article.

name: Bangladesh Government Official Nothi / Memo Report
description: Standard Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh Nothi & Memo structure (গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার নোথি / স্মারক কাঠামো).
context: Official administrative memo, inspection report, or policy brief for ministries, departments, directorates, and government commissions in Bangladesh. Adheres to Bangladesh Secretariat Instructions.
rules:
1. Format according to official Bangladesh Secretariat Nothi conventions.
2. Header must prominently state: 'গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার' / 'Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh'.
3. Use formal administrative Bengali/English terminology (e.g. বিষয়, স্মারক নং, পটভূমি, পর্যবেক্ষণ, সিদ্ধান্ত ও সুপারিশমালা).
4. All recommendations must be numbered, unambiguous, and assigned to designated administrative wings.
requirements:
- Ministry / Division / Department Name.
- Official Memo / Nothi Reference Number (স্মারক নং).
- Date in official format (Bangla & Gregorian).
- Subject / বিষয় (clear, one-line thematic summary).
- Background & Context (পটভূমি ও ভূমিকা).
- Detailed Observations & Findings (পর্যবেক্ষণ ও তথ্য-উপাত্ত).
- Decisions Taken (গৃহীত সিদ্ধান্তসমূহ).
- Strategic Recommendations (সুপারিশমালা).
- Designated Signatory / Authority Block (স্বাক্ষরকারী কর্মকর্তা).

fields.label: Ministry / Division (মন্ত্রণালয় / বিভাগ)
fields.default: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / স্বাস্থ্য ও পরিবার কল্যাণ মন্ত্রণালয়

fields.label: Subject (বিষয়)
fields.default: জাতীয় স্বাস্থ্য নীতি ও প্রোগ্রাম বাস্তবায়ন পর্যালোচনা প্রতিবেদন প্রসঙ্গে।

sections.title: ১. পটভূমি ও ভূমিকা (Background & Introduction)
sections.prompt: Comprehensive background, legal mandate, and context of the administrative inquiry or meeting.

sections.prompt: Actionable, numbered recommendations with timelines for ministerial execution.

sections.title: ৫. স্বাক্ষরকারী ও অনুলিপি (Signatory & Distribution Block)
